svg.title: Two ways to name the subtree
svg.desc: The log runs from entry 0 to 1,037. A batch of 37 new entries from 1,000 to 1,037 is covered by two subtrees, [992, 1024) and [1024, 1037); the first starts a little before the batch. These are signed right away and give standalone certificates with 5 proof hashes and three cosignatures. Later landmark 1 at size 1,037 is covered by [0, 1024) and [1024, 1037). Entry 1,005 sits in [0, 1024), a 10-hash proof, and the browser already holds that subtree hash, so no signature is needed.

text.tspan: the whole log, landmark 1 at tree size 1,037
landmark subtree [0, 1024): the browser already holds its hash
(the left one starts before the batch)
landmark-relative: 10 hashes, 0 signatures (344 B). Bigger subtree, smaller certificate.
at real scale: about 12 hashes against about 23 (draft §6.5).
